title: Elkhorn Ranch and White River National Forest Conveyance Act of 2017
official_summary:
Elkhorn Ranch and White River National Forest Conveyance Act of 2017

(Sec. 2) This bill requires all interest of the United States in approximately 148 acres of identified land to be conveyed by patent to the Gordman-Leverich Partnership (GLP), a Colorado Limited Liability Partnership.

The conveyance: (1) is subject to the valid existing rights of the lessee of federal oil and gas lease COC-75070 and any other valid existing rights, and (2) shall reserve to the United States the right to collect rent and royalty payments on such lease for its duration.

The conveyance shall: (1) be completed by no later than 180 days of enactment of this bill; and (2) be without consideration, except that all costs incurred by the Department of the Interior relating to any survey, platting, legal description, or other activities carried out to prepare and issue the patent shall be paid by the GLP to Interior prior to the conveyance of such land.

summary.headline: A 2018 law requires the federal government to transfer about 148 acres of land in Colorado to a private partnership, the Gordman-Leverich Partnership.
summary.what_it_does: The law requires the United States to convey its interest in about 148 acres of identified land to the Gordman-Leverich Partnership, a Colorado limited liability partnership, by patent. The transfer is made without payment for the land, but the partnership must repay the Interior Department for its survey, platting, legal description, and other costs before the transfer. The transfer is subject to existing rights, including those of the holder of federal oil and gas lease COC-75070, and the federal government keeps the right to collect rent and royalties on that lease for its full term.

who_it_affects.how: The Colorado partnership receives ownership of about 148 acres of federal land at no purchase price, but must first pay the Interior Department's costs of preparing the transfer.

who_it_affects.group: Holder of federal oil and gas lease COC-75070
who_it_affects.how: The lease holder keeps its valid existing rights in the land and must keep paying federal rent and royalties under the lease.
The department must complete the transfer of the land and is reimbursed by the partnership for the work needed to prepare it.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The land transfer must be completed within 180 days after the law was enacted on October 3, 2018.
